headline: US-led strikes hit Iran ninth night; Russia fires 166 weapons at Ukraine
subheadline: CENTCOM struck Tabriz and Bandar Abbas while Russia destroyed Kyiv's UKRTAC armor plant with a missile.
lede: US CENTCOM launched a ninth consecutive night of strikes on Iranian cities including Tabriz, Bandar Abbas, Chabahar and Mahshahr. Russian forces fired 166 air weapons at Ukraine, destroying the UKRTAC plant in Kyiv. Iranian drones hit Kuwait's main power station as Israeli and Jordanian forces intercepted ballistic missiles toward Aqaba.

sections.title: Russian Mass Aerial Assault on Kyiv
sections.body: Russian forces launched 166 air weapons including 41 missiles and 125 drones primarily at Kyiv, with 23 missile and 10 drone impacts confirmed. A direct missile hit completely destroyed the UKRTAC military equipment manufacturing plant and warehouses in Kyiv though all staff survived. Ground forces are reported approximately 8 km from Slaviansk per a company commander cited by TASS. Enemy strikes killed three in Kharkiv outskirts and one in Zaporizhzhia, with Iskander-M threats declared from Crimea and Taganrog.

sections.title: Sustained US Strikes and Iranian Retaliation
sections.body: US CENTCOM launched a new wave of strikes against Iranian targets for the ninth consecutive night hitting Tabriz, Bandar Abbas, Chabahar and Mahshahr. Israeli forces destroyed Hamas terror infrastructure in Gaza including a weapons warehouse and launch site overnight. Kuwaiti air defenses intercepted Iranian drones with one falling on the main power station, and Israeli and Jordanian forces intercepted Iranian ballistic missiles toward Aqaba. Two tankers exploded south of Hormuz per IRGC and explosions were reported in Tabriz at 2:37 AM.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The operational picture shows major US-led escalation against Iran with strikes across at least eleven cities and Iranian cross-border retaliation toward Jordan and Kuwait demonstrating spillover risk. Russia's sustained 166-asset deep-strike and ground advance to ~8 km from Slaviansk indicate continued pressure on Ukrainian defenses and expanded drone warfare.
